Author: refrakts (fork of Anomek's AnoMech)
Name: SevMech
Punchline: Severe Mechanics: an FFXIV mechanics simulator forked from AnoMech. Go to an inn and start practice.
Description: Fork of AnoMech that spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. Everything from AnoMech, plus more fights and strats. Only one of AnoMech and SevMech can be installed at a time.
